verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents strong 'insights from data' capabilities: RAG over uploaded docs/PDFs/CSVs and even YouTube videos, persistent memory of facts/preferences, and agentic web search that autonomously explores and cites sources (open-webui-docs-15, -28, -40, -39, -30, -41). However, independent hands-on reports directly contradict this core mechanism, stating RAG 'never worked' for them and failed even with external APIs and no local compute (open-webui-comm-3, open-webui-comm-4), a concrete functional failure rather than mere skepticism. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that RAG/insights work reliably in typical (non-GPU) deployments, and resolution of the documented RAG failure reports.
